ops.body: Dropped the criterion "On a fresh Sprite built from the release, a first concurrent use initialises ~/.wn_data/wn.db once and it passes PRAGMA quick_check". Owner steering 2026-10-10 (cci drive orca-remote-managed, lane agent-guidance): "we also dont need to eagerly do wordnet at all jsut leave the agnet instructions on how to do it if it needs it". A concurrent first WordNet use on a Sprite is no longer a rollout gate. Nothing provisions WordNet at startup, in a bake, or by a hook; Captain Hook's on-demand build is unchanged, and a task that needs the lexicon ahead of time gets one optional setup instruction in the docs.
